item.title: Duke De Sessa Out Of Autumn Racing Carnival
item.description: Ciaron Maher Racing has notified Racing NSW Stewards that DUKE DE SESSA has sustained an injury to its near foreleg and will not participate in the Sydney Autumn Racing Carnival. All wagering operators are therefore requested to remove DUKE DE SESSA from Autumn Carnival feature race betting markets.
